description: This file defines a Roslyn code fix provider class 'GenerateAliasAttributesCodeFix' that adds alias attributes to code elements such as methods and type declarations based on diagnostics identified by 'GenerateAliasAttributesAnalyzer'. It includes methods for registering code fixes, creating attribute syntax nodes, and applying fixes asynchronously.

classes.name: GenerateAliasAttributesCodeFix
classes.description: A Roslyn code fix provider class that adds alias attributes to code elements based on diagnostics.

methods.name: RegisterCodeFixesAsync
methods.description: Registers code fixes for diagnostics by analyzing syntax nodes and applying fixes to methods or type declarations.

methods.name: FixFor
methods.description: Creates and registers a code fix that adds an alias attribute to a method or type declaration based on diagnostic properties.
